katie_infra: Heads-up: planned loadtest tomorrow 08:00 UTC in eu-west3. We need a 6-hour extra burst of 8 A100s. Can procurement/vendor ops confirm availability & estimate cost delta? cc @jin_procure @sam_oncall
jin_procure: Checking with RackVendor — they have a standby pool but charge burst credits. I'll ping their ops, should have ETA in ~2h. What's the exact sku? A100 80GB or 40GB?
katie_infra: A100 80GB. It's for model sweep on prod-like data. If vendor needs smaller SKU we can fallback to 40GB but need to adjust batch config.
vin_ml: I can reduce batch from 8->4 and switch sequences to 1024 for the sweep to run on 40GB. Would increase run time ~1.8x, ok if cost delta is high.
sam_oncall: Also note we need the quota bump in cloud console (project: redwood-inference-prod-eu). Jin, can you open a formal quota request? Otherwise cloud will reject the instances.
jin_procure: Opened ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-8921 — vendor says tentative hold for 24h, final confirm after invoicing. Cost ballpark +18% for burst credits. cc @finance
katie_infra: Thanks. Can someone post the terraform change we'll need so infra-oncall can approve quickly? Likely just increasing reserved count in module/gpu_pool.
jin_procure: Pushed a quick PR to speed up approval: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/2987 — adds optional burst_count and metadata tags. Sam, can you run the smoke plan?
sam_oncall: Will run plan now. small nit: ensure `max_preemptible` stays 2 to avoid evictions during canary. Running: `terraform plan -var 'region=eu-west3' -target=module.gpu_pool`
ops-bot: Quota request INF-8921 created by jin_procure · Status: pending_vendor_confirm · ETA: 2026-03-21T14:00:00Z
vin_ml: :thumbsup: I'll adjust the sweep script and push a config PR after Jin's PR merges.
katie_infra: If vendor can't confirm by EOD, let's fallback to renting 4 A100 80GB + 8 40GB. Jin — can you price both options in the ticket?
jin_procure: On it. Also asked vendor for a short-term invoice to lock rate. Will update ticket and ping here.
sam_oncall: Plan succeeded locally, no conflicts. waiting on vendor confirm before apply. If approved, I'll schedule apply at 06:30 UTC to avoid peak.
katie_infra: SG. Appreciate the quick turnaround. Will also send a short note to product to delay the sweep kickoff by 2h if needed.
